criteria.quote: Weezing may not be born. Two Koffing can fuse.
criteria.revision: Replace the generic claim with the specific contradiction: "Weezing may not come from one Koffing at all—two Koffing can fuse into one over many years."
Add the concrete condition from the Pokédex: "Where two kinds of poison gases meet, two Koffing can fuse into a Weezing over many years."

criteria.quote: Does Weezing evolve from one Koffing, or can two Koffing become it together?
criteria.revision: Move this open loop into the first narration so the viewer immediately has the question the later scenes answer: "Does Weezing evolve from one Koffing—or can two Koffing become it together?"

criteria.quote: First, two Koffing encounter two different kinds of poison gas.
criteria.revision: The middle scenes repeat the same fusion fact. After establishing the long process, escalate with the research-backed alternative: "But another Pokédex entry says that, very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing becoming conjoined as a Weezing."

criteria.quote: Very rarely, a mutation makes two small Koffing become conjoined Weezing.
criteria.revision: Make the late reveal sharper without overstating it: "And the slow-fusion explanation isn't the only one: very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing becoming conjoined as a Weezing."
Cut or combine the repeated fusion beats. Use one scene for the long-term origin and another for the distinct rare-mutation account, rather than repeating "fuse," "formed," and "two become one."

criteria.quote: Weezing may have two origins: years of gas-driven fusion or a rare sudden mutation.
criteria.revision: Resolve the opening with the exact evidence and preserve its uncertainty: "The Pokédex gives Weezing two possible origins: two Koffing fusing where two kinds of poison gas meet over many years, or—very rarely—a sudden mutation producing conjoined twins."

criteria.quote: Which origin feels stranger: slow fusion or sudden mutation?
criteria.revision: Make the split depend on the two credible explanations rather than personal taste alone: "Which explanation do you accept for Weezing: two Koffing fusing over many years, or the rare sudden-mutation account?"
